items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Yeah, he played, he played, he played on records, on some of the records. ... With the Big Collins and them.

ctx.x: And you were talking about Joe Strutter, too. We were talking about Joe Strutter before we came here. Did you ever know Joe Strutter?

Yeah, he played, he played, he played on records, on some of the records. Oh yeah? Yeah. With what band? With the Big Collins and them. Oh. Yeah, Joe Strutter. Yeah, Joe Strutter. He was a good drummer, too, boy. What happened to him? He died, too, huh? No, he run away. I didn't know what happened to him. Oh yeah? It wasn't so long, boy. I didn't know what happened to him.

I think there's some Strutter still in town. We could probably find his family. I mean, I think he must have some family here, because that name, I see it all over town, Strutter. Yeah, Strutter, it might. Yeah, we might catch up. Do you have something? Yeah, yeah, I wanted to ask you, what did David Jones play like? Was he any good?
